I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The Lands of belowmentioned Names and Extents, depicted in Advance Tracing No. GA/MEE/2021/478 and dated 31.01.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village of Mineeoluwa in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 06, Kandalama in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Meerigama in Gampaha District in Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Extent: 0.0076 Hectare North: Lots 110,106,107, and 108 in Zone No.6 in Breakdown Map No. 510345; East; Lot No. 108 in Zone 6 in Breakdown Map No. 510345 and Lot No. A2 in same Tracing; South: Lot A2; West: Lots 110,106, and 107 in Zone No.6 in Breakdown Map No. 510345.

02 . Lot ‘A2’ – Kuriyankotuwa – Extent: 0.1030 Hectare North: Lot A1, Lot 108 in Zone No. 6 in Breakdown Map No. 510345 and Road (Road) Development Authority); East; Road (Road in Development Authority) and Lot No.1 Zone No. 7 in Breakdown Map No. 510345; South:Lot No.1 Zone No. 7 in Breakdown Map No. 510345; West: Lot No.110 in Zone No. 6 in Breakdown Map No.510345 and Lot A1 in same Tracing.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref No.: 4-3/7/2021/HW/242.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, No.1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.17th January, 2023.
